title: Unbalanced If / End If
description: Error-prone rule — scripts whose If / End If nesting does not balance out, or that close an If that was never opened.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unbalanced If/End If means the control flow is not what the developer drew — branches silently fall through.
rule.remediation: Repair the If/End If nesting (add the missing End If, or remove the orphan End If).
